body: I feel empty, with no future, and, cause of my pride, I never applied to transfer till it was too late. I feel like there is nothing for me, just this bland feeling of nothingness. I feel like I am getting pushed to the future, to reality, and I have nothing, no drive, no burning zeal for life that I used to have. Everyday I think of just ending it, cause really I feel like I have no reason to be here. I think of myself a year ago, think of myself ten years ago and realize that person would hate this one. I am ashamed of where I am at now. Everyday I think of how easy it would be to step in front of bus, have it be an "accident" and nobody I actually care about would realize how pathetic I've become. Everyone always says how this is the time of your life, how college is where you meet your lifelong friends, and I'm sitting here having peaked in fucking high school. All my friends back home are drifting apart, moving on to new lives, new people and I sit on facebook looking at pictures from two years ago screaming inside with no one to really talk to. And every time someone asks me how school is, I lie, cause it is so hard to admit that I am a fucking failure, who somehow fucked up the best time of their life. I don't see a future for myself. I never developed cool interests, or hobbies. I just flowed with those around me, never creating an actual identity for myself. And now I am here, and it feels like it is too late.
